description: The person's own conversations with you in this project, from every place they talk to you (the web app, Telegram, Slack, their own AI). With nothing given, lists them, the latest first, each with its id, name, place, when it was last active and a short summary. With words, finds the messages that say them, in which conversation and when. With conversation (an id from the list), reads that conversation's messages whole. It reads only this person's own conversations and changes nothing.

conversation.description: a conversation's id, from the list, to read its messages whole

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

words.description: words to find in the conversations

name: conversations_read
title: Conversations read
